scope: Local changes only; no commit or push.

conditions.mobile: Narrow Chrome iframes; no physical iOS or Android device. Reduced viewport height simulates keyboard space. IME, form submission, right click and touch edge cases include synthetic DOM events.
conditions.performance: Three runs per page on localhost, warm cache, no network or CPU throttling; Sans selected for comparison. Baseline LCP sampling happened after scroll, so no before/after LCP claim is made.

visual.issuesFound: Narrow search titles clipped without an ellipsis; fixed with a dedicated text span.
visual.result: Final screenshots inspected; long titles now end with an ellipsis, controls stay within the viewport, grain remains subtle in both themes.

conditions.legacyReadingData: An old localStorage reading value is ignored and is no longer updated; existing browser data is not erased.
